decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed video, and in-car video evidence. Sargeant was attempting to overtake Bottas on the inside at turn 4. Sargeant, who never reached a point where he could have made the overtake, missed his braking point and hit Bottas who was already in the turn and to his right. Sargeant was wholy to blame.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
